description: This source file defines a utility class 'FormUtil' with static methods for handling form structures, string manipulation for XML tokens, date formatting, and converting concepts and drugs into HL7-compatible string representations. It is part of the OpenMRS project and provides helper functions used across the codebase to process forms and related entities.

classes.name: FormUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for form-related operations within the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: getXmlToken
methods.description: Converts a string into a valid XML token (tag name) by sanitizing special characters, handling invalid starting characters, and formatting.

methods.name: getNewTag
methods.description: Generates a unique XML tag name from a string, ensuring no duplicates within a provided list.

methods.name: getFormStructure
methods.description: Builds a sorted hierarchical map of FormFields for a given form, organizing fields by parent-child relationships.

methods.name: dateToString
methods.description: Overloaded method: returns the current date/time as a string formatted according to ISO 8601, or formats a given Date object similarly.

methods.name: getFormUriWithoutExtension
methods.description: Creates a string URI for a form combining form ID, version, and build without including an extension.

methods.name: conceptToString
methods.description: Converts a Concept object into a standardized HL7-compatible string representation.

methods.name: conceptToString
methods.description: Converts a Concept object and its localized name into a string suitable for HL7/form use.

methods.name: drugToString
methods.description: Converts a Drug object into a string formatted for HL7 and forms.
